reasons: Only 19 selected periods from five controlled experimental cases; iid operational sampling is not established.
Inlet and fan settings were coupled by the case design; observed correlation describes that design.
Inlet values cluster near three setpoints, with ties and gaps; a smooth Gaussian copula is not established.
Unequal accepted counts per case are selection outcomes, not operating-scenario probabilities.
A nonsingular empirical correlation would not establish statistical reliability or Gaussian-copula adequacy.
estimation.scenario_policy: Only an explicitly supplied latent-normal correlation matrix creates model B; no automatic fit or repair.
estimation.gaussian_copula_assumption: Uniform marginal CDFs transformed to correlated Gaussian scores; Gaussian dependence is assumed, not demonstrated.
estimation.endpoint_policy: Exact uniform endpoints have infinite normal scores; forward Nataf rejects endpoints rather than clipping them.
estimation.sobol_policy: Classical coefficient-based Sobol decomposition applies to A's independent reference measure. Do not reuse it for B's physical inputs. Indices in B's independent latent coordinates describe those coordinates.
